## 01 · Ad Brief to Script Pack
**Problem:** a small business knows its product but has no time to write video ads.

**What happens**
1. The owner sends `/ad Product | benefit | audience | language` to the Telegram bot (or an app calls the API).
2. An AI model writes a 24-second, 3-scene ad: on-screen text, voiceover and a ready-to-paste **Google Veo prompt** per scene, plus caption and hashtags.
3. The script is saved as a new row in the Google Sheets **content calendar**.
4. The owner gets everything on Telegram, each prompt in a tap-to-copy block.

The AI model is swappable: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Gemini, OpenAI, local Ollama).

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: All settings come from the .env file. Change them there, then run start.ps1.
